newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares seen steady in tight market.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares seen steady in tight market.

text.p: After falling for four sessions running, Chilean shares are expected to hold steady in thin turnover with little news expected to drive stocks in one way or the other, said traders.
"Volumes are very small. The market is squeezed as a result of the price adjustment," said one dealer.
Several stocks including sugar-maker Iansa could rise in a price correction after falling steeply Wednesday, they said.
The heavyweight electricity sector is seen broadly stable, although stocks could still suffer from profit-taking.
The 40-share .IPSA index ended Wednesday down 0.58 percent at 132.39 points. ((-- Margaret Orgill, Santiago newsroom, 562-699-5595x212))
